what: Two or three lines of a quote are typed out one character at a time — .05s apart on wide screens, .03s at 1024px and below. Each line rests .5s (the line’s data-delay) and starts late by the number of characters in the preceding lines × the interval, so the lines follow one after another. A .1em caret at the head of the line follows the characters and drops out once that line ends. The last line’s caret stays and blinks at 1s step-end, and .2s before the last character, is-complete (the flag that brings up the caption and source) and fx:done fire. With fit: bytes, the line font size is set to 200vw divided by the byte count of the longest line (Latin and spaces 2, Hangul and kana 3), or 300vw on narrow screens, so the longest line always fills the same width

options.narrow: Width (px) at which each-m·k-m applies, default 1024
options.start: load (default — hits after delay seconds) or event (when fx:play is fired on the element) — for hitting after the loader or page transition ends
options.delay: start: with load, pause before starting (s), default 0
options.fit: If bytes, sizes the row by byte count. Otherwise uses the consuming CSS size
options.k · k-m · max: Divisor for fit (vw) · narrow-screen value · max screen width (px), default 200 · 300 · 1800

use: First lineSecond row

from.where: index.html .ld-punch__phrase (line of the month — three lines above a white band, fit bytes) · about.html title · roots.html section name (data-delay .5·.8 per line)

note: The white band and base panel are not parts — the consumer lays them behind the rows. Row elements change only text. Row text is read on attach and kept as aria-label
